description:
We wanted to give a little more information about our upcoming Squidmar Color range, and what you'll actually need. Regardless of which set you get, we think you're going to love it.
Squidmar Color releases on October 22nd! Be sure to sign up for updates at the following link, and be automatically entered into our next giveaway.

https://www.squidmar.com/paints-signup

We're also going to be at Essen this year at the Vallejo booth. During our meet and greet time slots we'll be doing a prize wheel giveaway where you have the chance to win a bunch of Squidmar goodies.
